verdict.rationale: Docs describe balance-account funding pools (single pool or per-card balances) and relayed authorisation letting the issuer's own system approve/decline each authorization in real time — the mechanics of both prefunded and JIT-style funding are present. However, there is no explicit documentation framing this as a finance-lead decision with cash-flow tradeoffs, no dedicated 'prefunded vs JIT' comparison page, and no discussion of liquidity/cash-flow implications. Missing for 10: explicit prefunded-vs-JIT funding model comparison, cash-flow/liquidity tradeoff guidance, finance-lead-oriented documentation.
